{{BSE|542650}} | ISIN = INE112L01020 | founded = 1980 | founder = Dr. Sushil Kanubhai Shah | hq_location_city = [[Mumbai]], [[Maharashtra]] | hq_location_country = India | area_served = {{Unbulleted list|[[India]]|[[Sri Lanka]]|[[Uganda]]|[[Zambia]]|[[Kenya]]|[[Mauritius]]|[[Ghana]]}} | key_people = {{Unbulleted list|Dr. Sushil Kanubhai Shah ([[Chairman]])|[[Ameera Shah]] ([[Managing Director]])|Surendran Chemmenkotil ([[Chief executive officer|CEO]]){{cite web |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=11371299 |title=Metropolis Healthcare Ltd - Company Profile and News - Bloomberg Markets |website=Bloomberg |access-date=11 October 2021}} }} | services = Health care management | revenue = {{increase}} {{INRConvert|1228|c}} (FY22) | net_income = {{increase}} {{INRConvert|214|c}} (FY22){{cite news |title=Metropolis Healthcare slips after Q4 PAT tumbles 35% YoY to Rs 40 cr |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/metropolis-healthcare-slips-after-q4-pat-tumbles-35-yoy-to-rs-40-cr-122052500379_1.html |access-date=13 January 2023 |work=Business Standard India |date=25 May 2022}} | registration = | num_locations = 124 clinical laboratories across 7 countries | alexa = | native_clients = | num_employees = 4600+ (2021){{cite news |last1=Raghunathan |first1=Anuradha |title=Owler: Metropolis Lab |url=https://www.owler.com/company/metropolisindia |work=[[Owler]] |date=30 June 2021}} | website = {{URL|https://www.metropolisindia.com}} }} '''Metropolis Healthcare''', also known as '''Metropolis Labs''', is an Indian [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] chain of diagnostic labs, with its central laboratory in [[Mumbai]], [[Maharashtra]]. Metropolis Healthcare has a chain of 124 clinical laboratories{{cite news |last1=Leo |first1=Leroy |title=Diagnostic major Metropolis Healthcare Q2 net profit jumps 44% to ₹43 cr |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/company-results/diagnostic-major-metropolis-healthcare-q2-net-profit-jumps-44-to-rs-43-cr-11573559520435.html |publisher=[[Livemint]] |date=12 November 2019}} and 2400 collection centers across 7 countries including [[India]].{{cite news |last1=Batra |first1=Ekta |last2=Nair |first2=Prashant |title=Metropolis Healthcare's business outlook very positive for FY20, says MD Ameera Shah |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/healthcare/metropolis-healthcares-business-outlook-very-positive-for-fy20-says-md-ameera-shah-3322671.htm |publisher=[[CNBC TV18]] |date=14 May 2019}} The healthcare company was founded in 1980. The company went public in April 2019.{{cite news |last1=Sultana |first1=Nasrin |title=Metropolis Healthcare lists at 9% premium to issue price |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/metropolis-healthcare-makes-firm-debut-lists-at-9-premium-to-issue-price-1555302302060.html |publisher=[[Livemint]] |date=15 April 2019}} ==History== Metropolis was founded by Dr. Sushil Kanubhai Shah in 1980.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=11371299|title=Company Overview of Metropolis Healthcare Limited|last=|first=|date=|website=www.bloomberg.com|access-date=2018-11-22}} The healthcare company was started as a single diagnostic laboratory in Mumbai. Shah's daughter, [[Ameera Shah]], took over the pathology business in 2001. The company started out by partnering with local and regional diagnostic chains, thereby spreading its reach across the country. Metropolis Healthcare has expanded into new service areas, like Clinical Research, Hospital Lab Management and Wellness Solutions, in the past decade.{{cite web|url=http://www.thesmartceo.in/magazine/cover-story/startup-school-with-metropolis-healthcare.html|title=SmartCEO – Magazine – Cover Story – STARTUP SCHOOL WITH METROPOLIS HEALTHCARE|publisher=}} Metropolis Healthcare began its international expansion in 2005 with Sri Lanka being the first market. It further expanded to UAE in 2006, followed by Kenya in 2013{{cite web|url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/anuraghunathan/2015/02/25/metropolis-chain-of-diagnostics-labs-pushes-for-growth-across-india-and-africa/|title=Metropolis' Chain of Diagnostics Labs Pushes for Growth Across India and Africa|first=Anu|last=Raghunathan|website=[[Forbes]]|publisher=}} and Mauritius{{cite news|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/metropolis-healthcare-expands-its-footprints-in-mauritius-114101600969_1.html|title=Metropolis Healthcare expands its footprints in Mauritius|newspaper=Business Standard India|date=16 October 2014|publisher=|via=Business Standard|agency=Press Trust of India}}{{cite web|url=http://www.vccircle.com/news/healthcare-services/2014/01/14/diagnostic-chain-metropolis-expands-overseas-unit-mauritius-eyes|title=Diagnostic chain Metropolis expands overseas with a unit in Mauritius, eyes M&As in Africa|date=15 January 2014|publisher=}} and Ghana{{cite web |url=http://www.thetimesofafrica.com/content/metropolis-healthcare-full-swing |title=Metropolis Healthcare in Full Swing {{!}} The Times of Africa |website=www.thetimesofafrica.com |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150620185223/http://www.thetimesofafrica.com/content/metropolis-healthcare-full-swing |archive-date=2015-06-20}} in 2014. In February 2018, Metropolis partnered with [[National AIDS Control Organisation|National Aids Control Organisation]] (NACO) for a three-year project for diagnosis of HIV at 560 locations in India.{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/healthcare/biotech/healthcare/metropolis-healthcare-plans-to-add-800-centres-10-labs-by-fy19-end/articleshow/63451359.cms|title=Metropolis Healthcare plans to add 800 centres, 10 labs by FY19-end|date=2018-03-25|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2018-11-23}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.biospectrumindia.com/news/22/10384/naco-partners-with-metropolis-healthcare-for-hiv-viral-load-testing.html|title=NACO partners with Metropolis Healthcare for HIV Viral Load Testing|access-date=2018-11-23|language=en}} As of 2018, the diagnostic chain consists of 124 clinical laboratories and 2400 blood collection centers across India, [[Ghana]], [[Kenya]], [[Zambia]], [[Uganda]], [[Mauritius]] and [[Sri Lanka]].{{citation needed|date=June 2022}} In October 2019, Metropolis Healthcare acquired four individual laboratories, Doctor's Clinical Laboratory, Iyer Pathology Laboratory, Nagar Pathology Laboratory and Yash Clinical Laboratory, a subsidiary of Dr Lal PathLabs in Surat, Gujarat, for INR 18 crore. The acquisition was done in order to expand the penetration of Metropolis's wholly owned subsidiary Desai Laboratories.{{cite news |last1=K. Tiwari |first1=Ashish |title=Diagnostic firms Metropolis, Dr Lal PathLabs on M&A spree |url=https://www.dnaindia.com/business/report-diagnostic-firms-metropolis-dr-lal-pathlabs-on-ma-spree-2794148 |publisher=[[DNA India]] |date=3 October 2019}}{{cite news |last1=Leo |first1=Leroy |title=Metropolis Healthcare buys 4 new labs in Surat |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/metropolis-healthcare-buys-4-new-labs-in-surat-11569952614996.html |publisher=[[Livemint]] |date=1 October 2019}} In October 2021, Metropolis completed the acquisition of South Indian diagnostic chain Hitech Diagnostic Centre and its subsidiary Centralab Healthcare Services for {{INR}}636 crore.{{cite news |title=Metropolis Health completes acquisition of Hitech |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/metropolis-health-completes-acquisition-of-hitech-121102300584_1.html |access-date=13 January 2023 |work=Business Standard India |date=23 October 2021}}{{cite news |last1=V |first1=Narayanan |title=Hitech Diagnostic to add 40 centres in Tamil Nadu |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/hitech-diagnostic-to-add-40-centres-in-tamil-nadu/article65314958.ece |access-date=13 January 2023 |work=The Hindu Businessline |date=12 April 2022 |language=en}} ==Funding== ICICI Venture invested 35 crore in Metropolis in the year 2006 through its India Advantage Fund. In 2010, [[Warburg Pincus]] invested about $85 Million in Metropolis, paving a way for ICICI to exit.{{cite news|url=http://in.reuters.com/article/idINIndia-49651120100625|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161221101235/http://in.reuters.com/article/idINIndia-49651120100625|url-status=dead|archive-date=21 December 2016|title=Warburg Pincus invests $85 mln in Metropolis Healthcare|first=Reuters|last=Editorial|newspaper=Reuters|date=25 June 2010|publisher=}} The Shah family purchased the exiting stake from Warburg Pincus for a healthy return on investment.{{cite news|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/warburg-pincus-sells-27-stake-in-metropolis-back-to-shah-family-115040900816_1.html|title=Warburg Pincus sells 27% stake in Metropolis back to Shah family|first=Reghu|last=Balakrishnan|newspaper=Business Standard India|date=10 April 2015|publisher=|via=Business Standard}} The company is backed by several investors including [[The Carlyle Group|Carlyle Group]], CA Lotus Investments{{Cite news|url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/enterprise/d-street-beckons-metropolis-healthcare/102522|title=D-Street beckons Metropolis Healthcare|access-date=2018-11-23|language=en}} and [[Kohlberg Kravis Roberts]] (KKR). In 2015, KKR backed Ameera Shah through {{INRConvert|5.6|b|lk=|year=2015}} promoter debt funding.{{Cite news|url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/venture/the-kkr-way-to-smart-returns/101625|title=The KKR way to smart returns|access-date=2018-11-23|language=en}} In April 2019, the company raised Rs 530 crore from 26 anchor investors, including Small Cap World Fund, Neuberger Berman Emerging Market Equity Fund, Fundsmith Emerging Equities Trust PLC and First State Indian Sub Continent Fund, among others.{{cite news |last1=Shah |first1=Amit |title=Metropolis Healthcare raises Rs 530 crore from anchor investors |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/metropolis-healthcare-raises-rs-530-crore-from-anchor-investors/articleshow/68693207.cms |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=2 April 2019}} == Awards and recognition == Metropolis was awarded the Diagnostic Services Company of the Year by [[Frost & Sullivan]] in 2010.{{Cite news|url=https://ww2.frost.com/event/calendar/8th-annual-india-healthcare-excellence-awards/award-categories/past-award-recipients/|title=Past Award Recipients|work=Frost & Sullivan|access-date=2018-11-23|language=en}} In 2014, it was awarded India's Most Promising Brand by the World Consulting and Research Corporation, which was evaluated by [[Ernst & Young]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.apnnews.com/metropolis-healthcare-bags-indias-most-promising-brand-award/|title=Metropolis Healthcare Bags "India's most promising brand award"|access-date=2018-11-23|language=en-US}}{{Cite web|url=http://www.siliconcitynews.com/?p=15239|title=Metropolis Healthcare Bags "India's most promising brand award" – Silicon City News|website=www.siliconcitynews.com|language=en-US|access-date=2018-11-23}} In 2018 and 2017, [[Managing director|MD]] of Metropolis, Ameera Shah was ranked 36th and 46th respectively, in "India's Most Powerful Women in Business" by [[Fortune India 500|Fortune India]] Magazine.{{Cite web|url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/mpw/ameera-shah?year=2018|title=Ameera Shah – Most Powerful Women in 2018 – Fortune India|website=www.fortuneindia.com|language=en|access-date=2018-11-23}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/mpw/ameera-shah?year=2017|title=Ameera Shah – Most Powerful Women in 2017 – Fortune India|website=www.fortuneindia.com|language=en|access-date=2018-11-23}} in 2015, Shah was awarded as one of the Asia's Power Business Women by [[Forbes]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbesasia/2015/02/25/asias-power-businesswomen-2015-12-to-watch/#673cf3317440|title=Asia's Power Businesswomen, 2015: 12 To Watch|last=Scott|first=Mary E.|work=Forbes|access-date=2018-11-23|language=en}} == Philanthropy == In April 2017, Metropolis launched a scholarship and mentorship program, called "Medengage", for undergraduate and postgraduate medical students across India.{{Cite news|url=http://ehealth.eletsonline.com/2017/06/metropolis-healthcare-announces-medical-talent-outreach-programme/|title=Metropolis Healthcare announces medical talent outreach programme|access-date=2018-11-23|language=en-US}} In July 2017, Metropolis and the PCOS Society of India launched a [[Polycystic ovary syndrome|Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome]] (PCOS) awareness campaign called "Conquer PCOS".{{Cite news|url=https://www.biospectrumindia.com/news/16/9311/metropolis-healthcare-pcos-society-of-india-launch-conquer-pcos.html|title=Metropolis Healthcare & PCOS Society of India launch 'Conquer PCOS'|access-date=2018-11-23|language=en}} In August 2018, Metropolis initiated an "Umbrella Handshake" campaign to create awareness about health. The company donated {{INRConvert|2|m|lk=|year=2018}} towards this and other social welfare initiatives. Metropolis partnered with We Foundation and Red FM, to help in public outreach and campaign awareness.{{Cite web|url=https://brandequity.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/advertising/metropolis-healthcares-new-umbrella-handshake-campaign-aims-to-spread-the-message-of-wellness/65447719|title=Metropolis Healthcare's new #Umbrella Handshake campaign aims to spread the message of 'Wellness' – ET BrandEquity|last=www.ETBrandEquity.com|website=ETBrandEquity.com|language=en|access-date=2018-11-23}} ==See also== *[[Dr Lal PathLabs]] *[[SRL Diagnostics]] *[[Thyrocare]] ==References== {{reflist|2}} == External links == * {{Official website|https://www.metropolisindia.com}} [[Category:Health care companies of India]] [[Category:Indian health websites]] [[Category:Laboratories in India]] [[Category:1980 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1980]] [[Category: 2019 initial public offerings]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:KKR & Co. companies]] [[Category:The Carlyle Group companies]] [[Category:Warburg Pincus companies]]
extract: Metropolis Healthcare, also known as Metropolis Labs, is an Indian multinational chain of diagnostic labs, with its central laboratory in Mumbai, Maharashtra. Metropolis Healthcare has a chain of 124 clinical laboratories and 2400 collection centers across 7 countries including India. The healthcare company was founded in 1980. The company went public in April 2019.
